stemMd: A row of 11 trees is planted at equal spacing of 4 m. What is the distance from the first tree to the last?
explanationMd: Eleven trees create ten gaps between the first and last. Each gap is four metres, so total distance is 10 × 4 = 40 m. Objects and intervals differ by one in a single row.

distractorRationale.b: This counts eleven intervals instead of ten.
distractorRationale.a: This adds an extra interval at each end.
distractorRationale.e: This is only the distance between adjacent trees.
